blocks.text: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia—A new Houthi attack struck Riyadh’s international airport on Sunday, a day after an earlier assault claimed by the Yemeni group killed at least a dozen people and prompted authorities to suspend airport operations. The latest strike killed one person, a Pakistani resident, and injured 11 others, according to Saudi Arabia’s civil aviation authority. […]...
